snippet.title: Sonic character designer game
snippet.description:
Sonic Character Designer is interesting game on Gamessonic.com. You try create your own Sonic character with customized hair and dress and everything else that best suits your personality. 
Play game: http://www.gamessonic.org/play/Sonic-character-designer.html
Fanpage: https://www.facebook.com/pages/Sonic-Game/244274442422672
